purpose: Viewport percentage bases: 81 development controls = 78 exact and three retained scaled-viewport use rejections. Root/nested viewBox extents, use positions/default dimensions, supplied image sizes, aspect modes, percentage roots and sibling restoration. Explicit matching-aspect viewports avoid intrinsic image cropping. Separate from the original and corporate denominators.
